plang/programming-fundamentals/1-1-terms.comment: The document offers an exceptionally clear and intuitive breakdown of core software development terms, successfully highlighting the functional necessity of intermediate build stages like ASTs and assembly. However, while it effectively contrasts key trade-offs like compile-time safety versus runtime flexibility, it operates primarily as an introductory overview rather than an exhaustive theoretical deep dive.

plang/programming-fundamentals/1-2-class.comment: The document provides a remarkably clear, structured, and accessible overview of programming language taxonomies, clearly contrasting operational mechanisms and trade-offs. While it excels at delivering intuitive conceptual boundaries and pragmatic context, it remains focused on high-level educational summaries rather than delving into lower-level theoretical foundations such as formal semantics or Turing completeness.

plang/programming-fundamentals/1-3-code-.comment: 본 문서는 프로그래밍의 기초 개념인 구문/의미의 차이와 기본 구성 요소를 명확하고 직관적인 구조로 명쾌하게 설명합니다. 다만 어휘 분석(Lexical Analysis)이나 AST(추상 구문 트리) 구성 등 컴파일러의 실제 내적 동작 메커니즘에 대한 심도 있는 논의가 부족합니다. 입문용 자료로는 뛰어난 가독성을 지니지만, LIQUID 철학이 지향하는 근본적 깊이와 심층적 이론 전개에는 일정 부분 한계가 있습니다.
